text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
First place!
I took first place--!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wait, whoa-whoa!
We walked right into the winner's circle!
choice_data_list: It's fine, you're the one who got 1st place after all.
It's fine, you're the one who took 1st place after all.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right!
Right, right, of couuuurse!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Did you see that?!
I got 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! You see, I went *whoosh* and ran really fast,
and then suddenly, there was nobody in front of me!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"The wind is super strong at the front!
Did you know? I had no idea!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And also, the Winner's Circle is super green!
It feels just a tiny bit rough to the touch!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And also, and also!
Let's see, let's see!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Taking 1st place really was so much fun!
Taking 1st place was super, super fun!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
I want to win way more 1st places!
choice_data_list: Yeah, we're gonna take 1st place again!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!!
I'm definitely gonna take 1st place again!
